description: This PHP file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ScopeRepositoryTest' for testing the 'ScopeRepository' in the OAuth module. It includes test methods for retrieving scope entities by identifier and for finalizing scopes, validating behavior of repository functions within the OAuth context.

classes.name: ScopeRepositoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class extending KernelTestCase for testing ScopeRepository methods in the OAuth module.

methods.name: testGetScopeEntityByIdentifier
methods.description: Tests that retrieving a scope entity by identifier 'profile' returns null, indicating no such scope is present.

methods.name: testFinalizeScopes
methods.description: Tests the finalizeScopes method for returning an empty array when given specific parameters including a mock ClientEntity.
